Subject: Evidence request: SCIM delta, SAML samples, role mapping

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the onboarding call earlier. Our security team reviewed Redwood's SIG and we have a couple of follow-ups to close our SOC 2 evidence pack:

- SCIM delta for the last 30 days (including deprovision events)
- SAML assertion samples (successful and failed auths) with timestamps
- Role mapping matrix showing which Redwood roles map to HealthSync entitlements
- Short description of JIT provisioning behavior and any time-to-provision metrics

I've attached our SIG questionnaire so you can see where each artifact will be used. Can we get a delivery ETA and an on-call contact for any clarifying questions? We need these for our auditor by 2026-12-07.

Appreciate it,

Alice Wong
Security Manager, HealthSync

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list, and welcome again. Looping in Rishi (Security/Controls) and Laura (AM) to scope artifacts and confirm timeline.

Quick answers / asks:
- We can pull a SCIM delta CSV covering 2026-11-01 through 2026-11-26. Do you need a rolling 30 days or this specific window?
- For SAML assertions we can provide anonymized assertion samples. Confirming whether your auditor needs raw NameID values or if redacted IDs are fine.
- We'll export the role mapping matrix and annotate which roles are considered admin/owner.
- JIT provisioning: short doc + on-call notes will be provided; we can include a small audit snippet showing provisioning latency for a sample of users.

Proposed ETA: initial bundle by 2026-11-30 EOD PST, with a 1-hour live call on 2026-12-01 if the auditor wants walkthrough.

Rishi/Laura — can you confirm attachments and whether we need to pull any additional auth logs for failed assertions?

Thanks,

– Marissa

Thanks Marissa — brief plan and artifact list below. I'll own the extraction and redaction work.

Artifacts we'll deliver by 2026-11-30 EOD PST (attachments noted):
1) scim_delta_20261101-20261126.csv — includes: timestamp,event_type (create/update/deactivate), user_id (redacted), user_email (obfuscated), source_system, affected_attributes
2) saml_assertion_samples.txt — 6 samples: 4 successful assertions, 2 failed (reason codes included). We will redact PII and mask NameIDs but keep timestamps and issuer/audience fields intact.
3) role_mapping_matrix_v2.xlsx — mapping from internal role IDs to HealthSync entitlements; admin roles flagged.
4) access_playbook_oncall_notes.pdf — short doc describing JIT provisioning flow, TTLs, and the on-call escalation path.

Notes / clarifying Qs for HealthSync:
- We will mask NameIDs as uid:XXXX. If your auditor requires real identifiers, we need an NDA amendment — please confirm.
- For failed SAML assertions, do you want we include full SAML status codes or just human-readable reasons?

Link to internal ticket with extraction steps: https://tickets.redwood.ai/INC-5231
Secure upload location for your team: https://drive.redwood.ai/secure/healthsync-evidence-upload

If this looks good I will start the export now and share a temporary GPG-signed bundle.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security & Controls | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Hi Rishi — thanks, that plan is perfect. A couple of clarifications before you redact: 

- Auditor prefers actual NameID values when possible, but we can accept masked values if you include a mapping key in a separate, encrypted artifact. Please do not send mapping keys over email.
- For failed assertions, please include the SAML status codes (e.g., AuthnFailed, NoPassive) and the corresponding timestamp windows.
- For role mapping, we only need a filtered CSV showing roles that map to admin/owner entitlements — that will speed review.

We'd like an on-call contact for the 2026-12-01 walkthrough — can Rishi or someone be available between 09:00–11:00 PST?

Thanks — forwarding the auditor's note to compliance if helpful.

Best,
Alice
